name: QM-like Projection Domain Registry

domain_features.name: distinction_by_exclusion
domain_features.definition: The emergence of discrete symbolic identity through the Necessity of Exclusion (E≠0).

domain_features.name: symbolic_discreteness
domain_features.definition: The treatment of aspect-bindings as discrete operational units within a projected frame.

domain_features.name: recursive_participation_measure
domain_features.definition: Quantification of how an aspect participates in an indivisible whole-relation.

domain_features.name: exclusion_thresholding
domain_features.definition: The limit condition beyond which an aspect is formally excluded from continuation.

domain_features.name: recursive_polarity_alignment
domain_features.definition: The alignment of process poles (-1 ⇔R +1) into stabilized symbolic orientations.
